problems: "Your portable copy keeps its own local data beside the executable, separate from a source installation." and "Source and portable installations keep separate stores." are partly wrong. The portable build keeps tasks, ideas, plans and conversations in resources\app\data. Settings, saved keys (auth.json), the project list, the Discord link and resume state live in %APPDATA%\Mefi's Studio AI+, and a source install on the same Windows account shares that folder. Only one of the two can run at a time; opening the second brings the running one forward. This is true of 0.4.4 as well; only the docs were clarified later.

"Use **App updates** to check for a newer portable release." No control named App updates exists in 0.4.4 or on main. The path is Settings › System › Updates › Published builds › **Check GitHub**, then **Update to vX.Y.Z** (updates.md already says this). README.md on main and faq.md repeat the wrong label.

"4. Choose a project folder, then select **Open studio** or **Open and start agents**." is right for 0.4.4. In 0.4.5 the launch screen changes. With no project it leads with **Open a folder…**, and the other button reads **Continue without a project**. With a project, the default button follows Settings › General › **When Studio opens** (Resume what I had, the default; Start agents; Keep agents off). When agents will start, the other button reads **Open with agents off**.

"**Help › Start here** guides you through installation, sign-in and a connection check." is true for 0.4.4. In 0.4.5 the **Setup helper** opens first on a new install, and once after updating. Its Quick setup is Connect an AI, Permissions, Finish, and Connect an AI leads with **Set up automatically** and **Start free with OpenCode**. It then hands on to Start here.
"Studio can use a Codex, Claude Code, Grok or Antigravity sign-in" leaves out OpenCode, which the guided CLI setup also installs and signs in.

From source: the npm ci steps are right. Source installs of 0.4.4 could lack the Electron 44 binary after npm ci. Main fixes this: a postinstall fetch (package.json "postinstall": "node scripts/fetch-electron.mjs"), the launcher downloads it once when missing, and npm ci stops on a Node older than 24 (engines >=24, engine-strict).

"After a crash or interrupted update, Studio may resume recent work automatically. A normal new session asks which project to open." 0.4.5 adds Settings › General › **When Studio opens**. problems: The page mixes the personal media player with community. The owner wants the site focused on community. Move media into its own page and lead with the Discord server, sharing projects and the Friends hub.

"Shared playback is still rolling out. It needs a configured rooms hub and a linked Discord account" is still true. The hub URL and link app ID are empty in scripts/hub-client.cjs and scripts/community.cjs. But 0.4.4 could only take them from environment variables (MEFI_STUDIO_HUB_URL, MEFI_STUDIO_DISCORD_CLIENT_ID). 0.4.5 adds **Settings › General › Community › Connection details**, where each PC saves them once; Save says whether the hub answered (6b633be).

"1. Choose a room in **Listen together**." does not say where. It is the Music & video menu's Links source (Settings › Audio › Links). In 0.4.5 it is also reachable from companion › Friends › **Friends & listening rooms**.

"We want to bring community conversations and cowork spaces into Studio... These aren't included in 0.4.4." Both are built on main (coming 0.4.5, rolling out).
- **Friends › Rooms**: browse your rooms and listed ones, **Ask to join** with a note, accept or decline invites, **Let them in**, and **Make a room** (Hangout up to 25, Cowork up to 10; needs the Room Host role).
- Room owners can lock or close; each room has plain-text chat with @names and **Report**.
- Cowork rooms: **Use this room for this project's agents** makes builders claim files across PCs.

Missing (coming 0.4.5): **Friends › Playground**. Companions meet in a room and play short scripted playdates. **Practice with Pip** works on one PC with nothing sent. Sharing levels are Stay home, Play only (default), Say hi, Status and Work titles, and **What was sent** lists every card that left.

Missing (coming 0.4.5): **Share with friends**. One brain, Playbook recipe, team setup, model results, memory note or preferences goes into a scrubbed, previewed `.mefishare` file. A friend's file is reviewed before it reaches your library. This needs no hub.

"The server also has a new bot called **Studio**." The name is unverified (default BOT_NAME is Void). The bot README lists:
- @mention chat and /ask, which answers from a wiki snapshot
- /showcase, /me, /cowork start, /room, /nowplaying, /forget-me, /privacy and Mark as solution
- participation roles: Member, Regular, Builder, Helper, Mentor, Spotlight, Cowork Host, Room Host, Patron, Contributor
The owner should confirm which of these are live.

The owner's community plans have no status. None of these exist in code, so they are "idea":
- credits for playing or looking at others' projects
- spending credits to promote your project
- cosmetics or styles for credits
- sharing mixes and showing the most-played ones when music taste sharing is on
The nearest shipped piece is the opt-in **Share what I'm playing**, which feeds /nowplaying. Present these as ideas with constraints. Discord's Platform Manipulation policy bars rewarding server joins, so nothing rewards invites (docs/community.md; bot docs/roles.md). Every theme and node style is currently free.
Missing: how to request features and give feedback. Use the GitHub feature_request template (label enhancement) or the Discord. GitHub Discussions is not enabled on the repo.

newPages.title: Permission modes
newPages.summary: Decide what Mefi may start and answer on its own, and undo its choices
outline: Status: released in 0.4.4; clearer descriptions and the Auto build fix come in 0.4.5.

The four modes, in the app's own words:
- Always ask: every new task, yours too, waits for your OK.
- Accept per task: OK once, then Mefi handles ordinary asks.
- Auto (default): tasks start on their own, agent proposals included.
- Elevated only: your tasks start, but tasks agents propose wait.

Elevated switches keep six kinds of decision with you: grants, irreversible changes, closing work you created, agent-filed work, heavier models, and human to-dos. Turning off the first two needs a warning acknowledgement.
What always waits for you: owner holds, desk escalations, and "already done?" checks on work done outside Studio.
Decided for you: every automatic choice keeps its reason with **Why** and **Undo**. The For you list holds human-only to-dos. Answers the desk gave are labelled "Mefi decided".
Learning: Mefi learns from your answers, scoped to This project + others, This project or All projects. You can turn it off or use Forget.

Where to change the mode:
- the composer chip in Vibe
- Vibe › Settings
- the companion's Personality bubble
- Agents › Overview
- Setup helper › Permissions
- Ctrl K
The old Auto build / Verify first switch maps to these modes.

outline: Status: released in 0.4.4 (Friends › Your PCs, Sync this PC). The rest comes in 0.4.5 and needs Git and a GitHub sign-in, not the rooms hub.
What Your PCs shows: uncommitted files, unpushed commits, stashes, worktrees and branches not on GitHub. Opening it only looks.

**Keep this PC up to date** (on by default): a GitHub check once a minute, then a fast-forward when nothing is in the way.

- Shelves: model results, learned decisions, team setups, brains, Playbook recipes, Claude Code memory notes, preferences, open tasks and ideas.
- Every item is checked on the way out and on the way in; nothing is overwritten.
- Keys need a typed confirmation.
**Share with friends**: one item in a scrubbed, previewed .mefishare file; a friend's file is reviewed before it reaches your library.

notes:
I audited all 12 pages and checked the claims against main and the v0.4.4 tag, not the local working tree. The task said that tree was clean, but it is not: 13 renderer files are modified and one test file is untracked. That uncommitted work is not reflected here. I edited nothing and made no git writes.

**Wrong facts that appear on more than one page, or in the app repo:**
- **"App updates" does not exist.** installation.md, faq.md and the app's README.md all use it. The real path is Settings › System › Updates › Check GitHub.
- **Search is not at the foot of the menu.** The top holds Vibe mode, New task and Search; only Settings and Help sit at the foot. shortcuts.md and README.md both get this wrong.
- **Portable and source installs share a data folder.** Both use %APPDATA%\Mefi's Studio AI+ for settings, keys, the project list, the Discord link and resume state, and only one can run at a time. installation.md and connections.md say they are separate.
- **Cowork rooms are no longer a future idea.** Friends › Rooms and cowork file claims are built on main (coming in 0.4.5). Their status should be "rolling out", because the hub address and the Discord link app ID are still empty in the code. home.md, community.md, the site README and docs/public-site.md still call them future ideas. "Hey Studio" is still only an idea.
- **The Discord bot's name.** The wiki and README call it "Studio", but the bot project defaults to "Void". The owner should confirm the name shown in the server.
- **Task state labels in workflow.md** do not match the app. Examples: "Awaiting build approval" shows as Awaiting approval, "Awaiting verification" shows as Verifying, and the new "Scheduled for later" is missing.

**Stale pages outside this audit:**
- faq.md: "App updates"; "Not in 0.4.4" for voice; "Tasks, conversations and local settings do not sync" (0.4.5's sharing vault can carry preferences, tasks and ideas).
- privacy.md: an "App updates" row; says rooms are rolling out.
- troubleshooting.md, tools.md and command-center.md: each is framed only around 0.4.4.
- Nothing in the wiki covers the Agent brain (J), Settings, Appearance, Vibe, the companion or permission modes, so new pages are proposed for them.

**The Discord bot's copy of the wiki is old.** Its /ask command searches a snapshot taken on 22 September from an older site commit. Its default link address still points at the old …/mefi-studio-site/wiki/#/ URL. Refresh it after the wiki changes.

**Bot docs:** docs/roles.md still says Discord membership unlocks member themes and node styles. That stopped being true in 0.4.4, when the Void collection became free.

**The owner's community economy ideas are not built.** There is no code for:
- credits for playing or looking at someone's project
- spending credits to promote your own project
- cosmetics or styles for credits
- sharing mixes and showing the most-played ones when music taste sharing is on

They should be marked "idea". Two constraints apply:
- Discord's Platform Manipulation policy bars rewarding server joins. Both docs/community.md and the bot's roles doc keep invites unrewarded, and the bot avoids rewards for message counts and has no leaderboard.
- Every theme and node style is currently free, so keep the free looks free.

The nearest shipped piece is the opt-in "Share what I'm playing", which feeds the bot's /nowplaying and is itself still rolling out.

**For the roadmap and feature requests:**
- **Done:** the CHANGELOG sections for 0.4.4 and earlier.
- **Coming in 0.4.5:** the CHANGELOG's Unreleased section.
- **Rolling out:** rooms, Listen together, Playground with friends, cowork claims and Discord linking (all need the hub and link app).
- **Being worked on:** docs/fleet-overhaul-plan.md (Phase 1, seats and the fleet model, is in progress).
- **Planned:** fleet-overhaul Phases 2–8. Phase 2 is next (Live › Fleet), then per-agent task lanes, missions and Refocus, and a progress monitor and budgets.
- **Planned (community):** docs/community.md Phase 4, cowork rooms that grant GitHub access, and Phase 5, shared agent-capacity pools.
- **Owner decision pending:** the unified page frame described in continuing.md.
- **Ideas:** "Hey Studio" voice (docs/public-site.md) and the community economy above.
- **Requesting features:** GitHub Discussions is off on the repo and there are no issues yet. Requests go through the feature_request template (label enhancement) or the Discord.

**Minor:** several pages.json titles differ from their page's H1 (home, installation, connections, shortcuts, workflow, planning, assistant, about-this-wiki, contributing).
